claim_b: 2023 White Paper: more than 14 million registered Buddhists (CHY-07); Pew 2023: 38% of adults identify as Buddhist (CHY-06)
position_taken: Use Pew 38% for self-identification; none measures chay practice
notes: Definitions differ: census self-declaration contested, White Paper counts registered followers, Pew is a probability sample of self-identity

claim_a: Hanoi sellers: volume 2 to 3 times normal (CHY-20)
claim_b: Hai Phong restaurant: orders down 20 to 30% on 2025 (CHY-21); Ho Chi Minh City: buying 'slightly up' (CHY-19)
position_taken: Both true: the seasonal multiple held, but year-on-year volume softened as costs rose
notes: Compare a multiple against normal days with a change against last year; they are not the same measure

topic: Direction of chay taste: mock meat versus natural
claim_a: Ho Chi Minh City 2024: mock meats were best sellers (CHY-26); periodic eaters prefer processed chay (CHY-09)
claim_b: Hanoi 2026: buyers prefer mushrooms, lotus, beans, vegetables over industrial chay (CHY-20; CHY-21)
position_taken: Treat as regional plus segment difference: southern periodic mass market buys mock meat; northern and strict buyers lean natural
notes: All sources are anecdotal press or observation; needs measured sales by region

claim_a: USSEC: tofu 11% of 286,000 t soy food in 2023, about 31,500 t (CHY-46)
claim_b: Craft village evidence: Hong Ha commune alone processes 20 to 30 t beans a day (CHY-48); Vong La over 80% of households at 150 kg beans a day (CHY-49)
position_taken: Prefer USDA 550,000 t soybean food use as the anchor; treat USSEC tofu figure as industrial tofu only
notes: USSEC basis unstated; craft data are old press

claim_b: Our read: at least 3,275 in 23 former provinces, September 2026 (CHY-31)
position_taken: Use our direct read with caveats; do not infer outlet growth
notes: Listings are cumulative; B-Company category definition unknown

claim_a: Thich Thanh Huan and Thich Minh Thanh: acceptable skilful means that reduces killing (CHY-53; CHY-55)
claim_b: Duong Lu Dien: mock meat damages compassion and keeps attachment to meat (CHY-54)
position_taken: Permissive on balance; no binding Sangha ruling found
notes: Both are opinion pieces or quotes, not Sangha directives

topic: Whether the five pungent plants rule applies to chay eaters
claim_a: Giac Ngo advisory: binds Bodhisattva precept holders, not lay lunar-day observers (CHY-52)
claim_b: Academic paper: Buddhist vegetarian diet excludes the five pungent plants (CHY-10)
position_taken: Follow Giac Ngo for lay practice; mainstream products already use alliums (FORM-01)
notes: The academic paper states the strict ideal without distinguishing lay practice

claim_a: B-Company article 1: 45% several times a week (CHY-13)
claim_b: B-Company article 2: 44% several times a week (CHY-14)
position_taken: Use neither as verified; underlying Statista values are paywalled; 2021 value is 44% (CHY-02)

claim_a: Street chay and supermarket đồ chay are cheaper than meat (CHY-38; FORM-01)
claim_b: Famous chay restaurants are more expensive than meat restaurants (CHY-37)
position_taken: Both true by segment: mass chay below meat, premium chay above

position_taken: Reject the 10% population claim; treat Rakuten as a panel figure
